NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to the camera
NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: This app needs access to Bluetooth
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Synara needs microphone access so you can record voice notes and transcribe them into the chat composer, and, if you turn it on, to move the chat message trail with your voice.
NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Synara reads how loud your Mac's audio is to animate the chat message trail. The audio itself is never recorded.
NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This app needs access to Bluetooth
